audio.transcript: Ladies and gentlemen, it's an honour to have the opportunity to address such a distinguished audience.
audio.instruction: Say the following with the same voice: 'Ladies and gentlemen, it's an honor to have the opportunity to address such a distinguished audience'

source.transcript: As he sat in his bench gazing calmly at the rector's shrewd, harsh face, his mind wound itself in and out of the curious questions proposed to it.

audio.label: Instruct TTS
audio.transcript: Welcome home. How was work today?
audio.instruction: Based on the following description: "一位二十多岁的女性，面对刚到家的伴侣，以温柔、关心且略带撒娇的语气轻声诉说。她的声音柔和亲密，语速稍缓，音量适中，音色甜美自然，在短语结尾处语调温暖地上扬。她正向伴侣问候回家，并温柔询问今日工作如何。", generate speech content "Welcome home, how was work today?".

audio.label: Speech Content Editing
audio.transcript: Do you think the biggest victory is not fighting for what we want and living well with dreams unmet?
audio.instruction: Replace 'but accepting what we cannot have' with 'and living well with dreams unmet'.

source.transcript: Do you think the biggest victory is not fighting for what we want, but accepting what we cannot have?

audio.label: Speed Editing
audio.transcript: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.

source.transcript: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
